name: grocerez-server
description: GrocerEZ API server (database layer set up by database-builder)

scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force && prisma db seed
scripts.db:check:demo: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U grocerez -d grocerez -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < prisma/seed/check-demo-list.sql
scripts.db:app-role: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U grocerez -d grocerez -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < prisma/sql/app-role.sql
